thread:
zoe: Heads-up — customer Icarus is seeing a token-shift after we merged their LoRA into rwd/gpt-large-int4 in int4 mode. Quick repro attached below.

mike: can you drop the exact prompt/output they saw?

zoe: example (redacted):
```
Input: 'Summarize the policy changes in plain english.'
Expected: 'The policy changes include...'
Observed: '<UNK> The policy changes include...'
```

anya: that <UNK> smell usually points at tokenizer id remapping or quantization rounding. saw something similar on the hawthorn test.

tom: did we run the tokenizer-remap script against the customer's tokenizer.json when merging?

zoe: yes — ran remap v2 and validated token ids for common tokens. fixed ~80% of failing prompts, but emoji + diacritics still misbehave.

mike: output diffs? even a tiny shift in prefix can cascade; would like short vs long answer diff.

zoe: uploaded quick-eval pack to CI: results show BLEU/ROUGE deltas + TokenShift metric per prompt. Top regression is ~12% token shift on short-answer set. Link in the CI job.

ci-bot: quick-eval job #4921 finished — artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/4921/artifacts (auth required) :white_check_mark:

tom: proposal: re-run merge with fractional weight scaling (0.92) before quantize, then re-eval. Also compare KV cold vs warm warm-start behavior — warm caches sometimes amplify small id issues.

anya: I'll spin up 4 variants tonight:
- base (current)
- remap + scale 0.92
- remap + scale 0.92 + kv-warm-fix
- remap + scale 0.92 + alt-quant (symmetric clamps)
I’ll run the icr prompt set and the standard regset.

zoe: timeline: need a customer-facing update by EOD tomorrow. Acceptance criteria: token-shift <3% on short-answer set and no new regressions >1% on long-form.

mike: if none of the variants meet criteria, prepare rollback to their prior adapter on dedicated and enable canary traffic (50rps) while we debug. I’ll draft rollback playbook.

zoe: noted. if the remap+scale variant passes, we can roll that as a hotfix and push a patch release.

sam: small ask — add the icr prompt set to our nightly regression suite so this doesn't slip.

zoe: done, added set id icr-token-shift-2026 to nightly.

tom: saved a deterministic reproducer at /mnt/bench/icr/repro-1758004321.json (contains minimal seed + token ids).

zoe: great work. thanks all — @anya ping me when the jobs finish and drop the perf table. :thumbsup:

anya: will do, starting runs now. expect results ~8hrs.

mike: thanks — I’ll prepare canary infra in parallel.

ci-bot: deploy check: canary infra template validated (template v3).

zoe: closing loop later, appreciate quick turnaround.
